findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on "#h01-card-3" for y, rotation between 1.20s and 1.40s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: Relative value(s) y: "+=12", rotation: "+=1.5" on "#h01-card-3" start while another writer for the same properties is active between 1.20s and 1.40s. Relative tweens capture their base at tween init: the sequential path inits mid-flight of the other writer, a cold render worker landing later inits with its end state, so the same frame renders at two different positions (snap at chunk boundaries).
findings.fixHint: Use absolute values for y, rotation, or a fromTo() with explicit endpoints, so every seek path resolves the same state. Single-writer relative values are safe; the conflict is the second writer.
